$comment: Field markings the view draws that are not in FieldGeometry yet (CR-G03-3 asks for rule keys). Pro values are read from the 2026 NFL rulebook, Rule 1 Section 2; college values from the 2026 NCAA rulebook, Rule 1 Section 2 Article 1. One source each, so the computed status is PROVISIONAL (Q6.3.1). Where a value matches a rule key (field.numbers_bottom_from_sideline_ft, field.numbers_top_from_sideline_ft) a test pins it to the rule-set row. Values the text does not state are listed under `assumed` per set and are display choices.

sources.title: 2026 NFL rulebook, Rule 1 Section 2 Articles 1, 2 and 4
2026 NCAA Football Rules and Interpretations, Rule 1 Section 2 Article 1 b, d, h and j

college_2026.$comment: Article 1-h recommends numbers no taller than 6 ft with tops 9 yd from the sidelines (bottoms 7 yd, the rule-set's 21 ft). The 5-yard lines and 1-yard hash spacing are drawn in Appendix D, which this text copy holds only as a diagram, so they are assumed to match the pro field. Rule 1 names no try-line marking for college, so none is drawn. Article 1-d keeps end-zone decoration (team names) at least 4 ft from any line; the pro text has no such figure, so the pro set assumes the same clearance.
